items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Was there a band by the name of Russ Morgan?

ctx.x: I think he did. Or maybe it was Jerry Jerome actually, I can’t really remember.
Flip played with Morgan. There was a Morgan he played with, and he played with Frankie Newton. That was his big thing. He was in in at Kelly’s Stable, but he played clarinet at that time.
So Woody Herman was the first big band that you had played with, of that size?
